1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Be7 4.d4 exd4 5..strategy: Drives the knight away with a pawn that gains space. The extra pawn on d4, attacked three times, will be won back, and White comes out with the better development and central space in return for an advanced e-pawn that Black can try to attack.

Centralises the knight, which hits c3 and f2, instead of retreating. Black keeps the extra pawn for the moment, but the knight is exposed to attack and White's space advantage tells, so White keeps the more comfortable game.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Be7 4.d4 exd4 5..name: Italian Game: Hungarian Defence, Tartakower Variation
